newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares end down, seen tracking U.S. Monday.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares end down, seen tracking U.S. Monday.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Friday, with attention on Sophus Berendsen and Monday's outlook seen dependent on Wall Street.

"There has been profit-taking in Berendsen after the share rocketed on news of its plans to split into two listed companies. If Wall Street does not fall further we should hold present levels on Monday," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 1.74 point lower at 163.77, while the KFX June future fell 0.50 point to 164.40 with 673 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
The Berendsen share closed 96 crowns higher at 985.00.
Also hit by profit-taking were Danisco, Unidanmark and Moeller.

Danisco closed 13 crowns down at 383, Unidanmark ended unchanged at 340, while Moeller's D/S 1912 shed 15,000 crowns at 325,000 and its twin D/S Svendborg lost 7,000 crowns to finish the week at 227,000.
